source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Review and summarize your incident records. After you have compiled a list of incidents and injuries and illnesses that require reporting under the OSHA regulations, complete OSHA Form 300 or 300A for the calendar year.  
3. The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) uses data collected by OSHA on the 300A logs to conduct an annual report on workplace injuries and illnesses in the private industry. You must keep this completed form in accordance with 1904.33, and post a summary of the information on OSHA Form 300A for the year, as required by 1904.32(b)(2). Make copies of it for your files.  
4. You must complete the summary (OSHA Form 301) of the illnesses and injuries. This form will be used to document and transmit information to OSHA.
